I offer here a few new readings, three of which would send Ὧρσις, Ἡρηκλαλαχ and Σωεύς to our lists of ghost names. Corrections from BL VIII have been included, as well as minor corrections to typos (from the edition and/or the DDBDP)

Submit - I offer here a few new readings, three of which would send Ὧρσις, Ἡρηκλαλαχ and Σωεύς to our lists of ghost names. Corrections from BL VIII have been included, as well as minor corrections to typos (from the edition and/or the DDBDP)
Commit - Supralinear strokes added where I could see them.
Commit - Line 61: no diaeresis in Παχοις
Commit - Line 51 had Δεῖος (Δῖος ed.) as in l. 63, though only the start of the epsilon survives.
Commit - Line 51: no diaeresis in Ζωίλου

Commit - New reading for l. 50, deleting the ghost name Ὧρσις (some damage on the papyrus might suggest the presence of a rho, but there is hardly enough space for ωρ); the name Ὠσις is well attested, including in Theadelphia, from which the papyrus might come
Commit - Day number corrected from photograph in l. 44

Commit - L. 41: instead of τα (ed.; τά in SB) αχανα, I would read from the photograph Τααχιλλε̣α. The name Τααχιλλευς is attested in PSI VII 799, 19, and is a standard name formation on a Greek name. Whether it stands here alone or serves as a mother's name for the person in the previous line (Pouïou) remains uncertain to me.
Commit - New reading for l. 39, deleting the ghost name Ἡρηκλαλαχ; the κῷα-unit was not omitted
Commit - Line 35: again, the number of Koa was not printed in the original edition

Commit - L. 33: instead of the otherwise unattested Σωεὺ̣ς̣, I would read from the photograph Σωις; the latter is taken by TM as a variant of Ζωίς; it appears to be rather uncommon: compare only P. Oslo III 134, 5; P. Neph. 31; 4; 15.
Commit - Line 27: number at the end missing in the edition (again)
Commit - L. 23: Κάστορος -⟩ (Κάστορ[ο(ς)])
Commit - Line 21: no diaeresis on Ζωιλ(ος)
Commit - Line 20: number at the end of the line is ι = 10 (missing by typo in original edition)
Commit - Line 17: Ἥρω[ν]ως -> Ἥρω[ν]ος (data entry error)
General - There might be a couple of other female names in this list (Tapouris, l. 11, but it's followed by ἱερεύς; see also l. 41)
General - Βερις/Βερεις is attested only a few times, as a female name, including: P.Mich. V 272, 1; 11; P.Oxy. 38 2858, 4; 5; 28.
General - Even if it's surprising to have day 10 between 12 and 13, the number stroke is clearly after the iota and before the supposed beta
General - About l. 14: Ἔρις has remained rare as a personal name and is taken by TM as a variant of Ἑριεύς (in part. P.Mich. IV 223 recto, col. XI, 280, where this seems right)
Commit - Added correction to number in line 3 and to date and name in line 14 (though the latter remains somewhat uncertain)
Commit - Added corrections from P.Ross.-Georg. II, p. 189, as reproduced in BL VIII 326
New reading in line 50, based on online picture (http://adore.ugent.be/view?q=001484442&submit=zoek&confirm_search=1&language=en)
